main.description: A file or folder in a drive. The record key is its permanent ID: renames and moves update the record, never the key. Everything but the blob refs is sealed with the drive key, so the PDS can't read it.

keyID.description: Public ID of the drive key it was sealed with.

sealed.description: AES-256-GCM ([format 0x01][nonce 12][ciphertext][tag 16]) of the JSON #payload, under a key derived from the drive key, with '<space URI>/me.jsnelgro.atdrive.node/<rkey>' as associated data.

chunks.description: Files only: the contents, split into chunks, each encrypted (same format as 'sealed', under a key derived from the drive key). Decrypted and concatenated in order, they are the file. Readable so the PDS keeps the blobs.

name.description: File or folder name. Not empty, not '.' or '..', no '/'.

parent.description: Record key of the folder this is in. Absent for the top level.

sha256.description: Files only: hex SHA-256 of the whole file.

chunks.description: Files only: the CIDs of the record's 'chunks', in order, so they can't be swapped.

modifiedAt.description: Files only: the file's own modification time.
